entries.title: Job 20:1
segments: And Zophar the Naamathite answered and said,

entries.title: Job 20:2
segments: Therefore my thoughts cause me to answer, even because of my haste in me.

entries.title: Job 20:3
segments: I have heard the rebuke meant to shame me, and the spirit of my understanding causes me to answer.

entries.title: Job 20:4
segments: Do you know this from [days] of old, from the setting of man on earth,

entries.title: Job 20:5
segments: that the exulting of the wicked [is] short, and the joy of the ungodly [is] for a moment?

entries.title: Job 20:6
segments: Though his honor mounts up to the heavens, and his head reaches to the clouds,

entries.title: Job 20:7
segments: he shall perish forever like his dung; they who see him shall say, Where [is] he?

entries.title: Job 20:8
segments: He flies away like a dream, and shall not be found, and shall be chased away like a vision of the night.

entries.title: Job 20:9
segments: An eye glimpsed him, but will not again; yea, his place shall not see him again.

entries.title: Job 20:10
segments: His sons shall seek to please the poor, and his hands shall restore his wealth.

entries.title: Job 20:11
segments: His bones are full of his youthful vigor, but it lies down with him in the dust.

entries.title: Job 20:12
segments: Though wickedness is sweet in his mouth, [though] he hides it under his tongue;

entries.title: Job 20:13
segments: [though] he spares it and will not leave it; yea, keeps it still in his mouth;

entries.title: Job 20:14
segments: [yet] his food in his belly shall be turned; the gall of asps [is] within him.

entries.title: Job 20:15
segments: He swallows riches, but vomits it; God shall cast them out of his belly.

entries.title: Job 20:16
segments: He shall suck the poison of asps; the viper's tongue shall slay him.

entries.title: Job 20:17
segments: He shall not see the rivers, the flowings of the brooks of honey and butter,

entries.title: Job 20:18
segments: giving back his gain, and he will not eat. As to the wealth of his trading, even he shall not enjoy [it].

entries.title: Job 20:19
segments: For he pressed down [and] forsook the poor; he stole a house, but he had not built it.

entries.title: Job 20:20
segments: Surely he shall not know quietness in his belly; he will not escape with the things of desire.

entries.title: Job 20:21
segments: None of his food shall be left; therefore his good will not last.

entries.title: Job 20:22
segments: In the fullness of his plenty he shall be in trouble; every wretched one shall come on him.

entries.title: Job 20:23
segments: It shall happen at the filling of his belly, [God] shall cast the fury of His wrath on him, and He shall rain on him while he is eating.

entries.title: Job 20:24
segments: He shall flee from the iron weapon, a bow of bronze shall pierce him.

entries.title: Job 20:25
segments: One draws it, and treads it from behind, even lightning from his gall; terror [is] on him.

entries.title: Job 20:26
segments: All darkness [shall be] hidden in his secret places; a fire not blown shall consume him; those left in his tent shall be broken.

entries.title: Job 20:27
segments: The heavens shall reveal his iniquity, and the earth rise up against him.

entries.title: Job 20:28
segments: The increase of his house shall depart, and shall flow [away] in the day of his wrath.

entries.title: Job 20:29
segments: This [is] the portion of a wicked man from God, and the inheritance of his word from God.
